title: snapshot
description: One weekly document, normalised. Produced by scripts/extract.py. The same shape whatever the source format, so the diff stage never branches on document type.

name.description: Stable across weeks — this is what pairs the two snapshots.

period_label.description: How the period is named in the meeting, e.g. 'Week 12'.

item_id.description: The matching key. Must identify the same real-world thing week to week — an activity ID, a learner, a RICEFWA object. Derived, never invented.

source_ref.description: Where in the document this came from — quoted back so a claim can be checked against the source.

text.description: Free prose for section and slide items; empty for tabular ones.
